## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and its scope.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] DSH composition test, when plugin behavior changes
- [ ] Desktop and narrow-window screenshots, when UI changes

## Project checks

- [ ] The change uses additive DSH extension points.
- [ ] New artwork includes source, license, and attribution details.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese documentation stay in sync.
- [ ] Material AI assistance is disclosed and its output has been reviewed.
- [ ] Logs and screenshots contain no secrets or personal paths.
